text: When with much labour she has borne to the end and brought forth her offspring, she feeds it and watches over it with tender care, not in return for any good thing previously received, for indeed the babe itself is little conscious of its benefactor and cannot even signify its wants; only she, the mother, making conjecture of what is good for it, and what will please it, essays to satisfy it;
author: Xenophon
speaker: Socrates
